drafted_from: tool:read-shared-decision's own row (its words, input schema and the sample run read from the made-up share in test/read-shared-decision.test.mjs); the share it reads is tool:share-a-decision's. It sits beside tool:share-a-decision, which keeps the entry it reads.
start_here: Say to your AI: "Read the anonymous version of this decision that I shared", with its decision_id and its records. It runs tool:read-shared-decision and answers the five shared fields with the review identity it was checked under, and nothing else.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes the decision, the message, the source chat and the handoff as input and keeps only the decision's own rows (decision, decision-history and the decision records it changes).
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Read the anonymous version of this decision that I shared", and give it decision_id.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-shared-decision and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: the shared entry, its review identity and when it was shared; a decision never shared is refused.
